mapper.select: INSERT INTO tour.tickets ( packages_id, ticket_amount, users_id ) VALUES ( #{data.packagesId}, #{data.ticketAmount}, (SELECT id FROM auth.users u WHERE u.email = #{email}) ) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tour.ticket_payments ( tickets_id, payments_id ) VALUES ( #{ticketsId}, (SELECT id FROM public.payments WHERE invoice_no = #{invoiceNo}) ) ON CONFLICT (tickets_id, payments_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tour.tickets t JOIN tour.ticket_payments tp ON tp.tickets_id = t.id WHERE users_id = (SELECT id FROM auth.users u WHERE u.email = #{email})
